outcome: Uterine tachysystole with non-reassuring fetal status
Proportion of cases requiring pre-delivery oxytocin
cohort: 92 multiparous women at ≥37 weeks of gestation requiring labor induction
finding: The proportion of pregnant women who had a vaginal delivery was significantly higher in the PROPESS group than in the oral dinoprostone group.
mod_finding: Women induced with a controlled-release dinoprostone vaginal delivery system had a higher vaginal delivery rate compared to oral dinoprostone.
